formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (e : Point) (f : Point) (g : Point) (h : Point) (AB : Line) (BC : Line) (CD : Line) (DA : Line) (EF : Line) (FG : Line) (GH : Line) (HE : Line), ((formParallelogram a b c d AB BC CD DA) ∧ (formParallelogram e f g h EF FG GH HE) ∧ (|(b─c)| = |(f─g)|) ∧ (∃ l r : Point, l.onLine AB ∧ r.onLine GH ∧ l = r ∧ ∃ l r : Point, l.onLine BC ∧ r.onLine FG ∧ l = r)) → ((|(a─b)| * |(b─c)|) = (|(e─f)| * |(f─g)|))

formalizations.formalization: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (e : Point) (f : Point) (g : Point) (h : Point) (AB : Line) (CD : Line) (EF : Line) (GH : Line), ((formParallelogram a b c d AB CD (by sorry) (by sorry)) ∧ (formParallelogram e f g h EF GH (by sorry) (by sorry)) ∧ (|(c─b)| = |(g─f)|) ∧ (between b c g)) → ((|(a─d)| = |(e─h)|))
formalizations.full_output: theorem example_thm (a b c d e f g h : Point) (AB CD EF GH : Line) (h1 : formParallelogram a b c d AB CD (by sorry) (by sorry)) (h2 : formParallelogram e f g h EF GH (by sorry) (by sorry)) (h3 : |(c─b)| = |(g─f)|) (h4 : between b c g) : (|(a─d)| = |(e─h)|) := by

reference_formalization: ∀ (a b c d e f g h : Point) (AH BG AB CD EF HG : Line), formParallelogram a d b c AH BG AB CD ∧ formParallelogram e h f g AH BG EF HG ∧ |(b─c)| = |(f─g)| ∧ (between a d h) ∧ (between a e h) → Triangle.area △ a:b:d + Triangle.area △ d:b:c = Triangle.area △ e:f:h + Triangle.area △ h:f:g
nl_statement: Parallelograms which are on equal bases and between the same parallels are equal to one another. Let $ABCD$ and $EFGH$ be parallelograms which are on the equal bases $BC$ and $FG$, and (are) between the same parallels $AH$ and $BG$. I say that the parallelogram $ABCD$ is equal to $EFGH$. <prf> So that the parallelogram $ABCD$ is  also equal to $EFGH$.Thus, parallelograms which are on equal bases and between the same parallels are equal to one another.
